sections.section_content: Hero workout of your choice.
section_notes: Pick a Hero workout that allows you to keep moving.
Good choices emphasize moderate rep ranges and a 15-20 minute time domain.

metadata.raw_content:
[Hero workout of your choice.](https://www.crossfit.com/heroes/)   
Review the list of heroes and honor one with an all-out effort.

Post choice of workout and results to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230911).
Compare to [220530](https://www.crossfit.com/230529).

**Scaling:**   
Most Hero workouts are meant to be extremely grueling, arduous, and mentally challenging. Many contain a very high volume of reps. As we’re just coming off of the Filthy Fifty, make sure you pick a Hero workout that allows you to keep moving. Hero workouts that emphasize moderate rep ranges and time domains (10-30 reps/movement, approximately 15-20-minute range) are good choices as well.

metadata.raw_content:
**Nancy**  
5 rounds for time of:   
Run 400 meters  
15 [overhead squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat)

♀ 65 lb ♂ 95 lb

OR  

**Helen**  
3 rounds for time of:  
Run 400 meters  
21 [kettlebell swings](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kettlebell-swing)  
12 [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-butterfly-pull-up)

♀ 16-kg KB ♂ 24-kg KB

*Default to Nancy, a classic CrossFit workout. [CAP affiliates](https://www.crossfit.com/programming) will be doing Helen today. If you have not completed Helen recently, give it a shot.*

Log Helen scores to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0). Post workout and time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230918).  
Compare to [230626](https://www.crossfit.com/230626) or [230802](https://www.crossfit.com/230802).  

***

**Scaling:**   
*Nancy:* Choose a load that allows you to complete most of the OHS unbroken. The challenge of this workout is to keep an aggressive pace on each element knowing that neither the lifting nor the running are so demanding on their own that you’ll need extended rests. Advanced athletes should resist the temptation to add load and instead commit to a run pace that’s just a little too hot.

*Helen:* Most athletes should aim to complete the swings and pull-ups unbroken. If you anticipate needing to break either movement more than one or two times, reduce the weight of the swings and consider completing ring rows instead of pull-ups. If you can complete Helen in less than 8 minutes, consider trying [Helena](https://games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2023?_ga=2.134508217.950528661.1693935248-1350194187.1693531355#events-details) from this year’s Games.

**Scaling:**  
If you cannot complete an L-sit pull-up, choose a variation of pull-up that allows you to complete approximately 10 reps during your first set. If you can complete 1-5 L-sit pull-ups, consider performing a set after each set of overhead lifts instead of after the final set of each movement.   

**Beginner option:**

Push press 3-3-3 reps   
Push jerk 1-1-1 reps   

After completing the final set of each movement, perform a max set of **ring rows.**

sections.section_content:
Every 4 minutes for 4 rounds, complete:
* **Double-unders**: 40
* **Bike**: 20 calories
* **Dumbbell snatches**: 10

**Weights:**
* Female: 50-lb DB
* Male: 70-lb DB
section_notes: Modify movements and weight to ensure you finish each round in 3 minutes or less.

metadata.raw_content:
Every 4 minutes for 4 rounds, complete:   
40 [double-unders](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-double-under)  
20-calorie bike   
10 [dumbbell snatches](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-dumbbell-power-snatch)  

♀ 50-lb DB ♂ 70-lb DB 

Post results to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230926).   
***  
**Scaling:**  
Modify the movements and reduce the dumbbell weight to sprint through each round in 3 minutes or less. 

**Intermediate option:**  
Every 4 minutes for 4 rounds, complete:   
40 double-unders   
20-calorie bike   
10 dumbbell snatches 

**♀ 35-lb DB ♂ 50-lb DB** 

**Beginner option:**   
Every 4 minutes for 4 rounds, complete:   
40 [single-unders](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-single-under)  
**12-calorie** bike   
10 dumbbell snatches   

**♀ 15-lb DB ♂ 20-lb DB**

sections.section_content:
AMRAP in 12 minutes of:
* 1 **Rope climb**
* 3 **Front squats**
* 3 **Push presses**

*Continue until time expires, adding 1 squat and 1 press each round.

**Weights:**
* Female: 95 lb
* Male: 135 lb
section_notes: Beginners can reduce the load and modify the rope climb to lying-to-standing.

metadata.raw_content:
Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:   
1 [rope climb](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-rope-climb-wrapping)   
3 [front squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-front-squat)   
3 [push presses](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-press)   
1 rope climb   
4 front squats   
4 push presses   
1 rope climb  
5 front squats  
5 push presses  
1 rope climb  
6 front squats  
6 push presses 

Continue until time expires, adding 1 squat and 1 press each round. 

♀ 95 lb ♂ 135 lb
 
Post reps completed to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230927). 
***  

**Scaling:**  
Intermediate athletes should be able to attack this workout as prescribed. Beginner-level athletes can reduce the load and [modify the rope climb](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-modified-rope-climb).

**Beginner option:**     
Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:   
1 rope climb, [lying to standing](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-modified-rope-climb)   
3 front squats  
3 push presses   
1 rope climb, lying to standing   
4 front squats   
4 push presses   
1 rope climb, lying to standing    
5 front squats  
5 push presses   
1 rope climb, lying to standing    
6 front squats   
6 push presses 

Continue until time expires, adding 1 squat and 1 press each round. 

**♀ 35 lb ♂ 45 lb**

sections.section_content:
On a 25-minute clock:
* **Run** 1.5 miles

Then perform AMRAP of:
* 10 **Push-ups**
* 20 **Lunges**
* 30 **Sit-ups**
section_notes: Deconditioned athletes should reduce overall volume while maintaining the format.

metadata.raw_content:
On a 25-minute clock:  
Run 1.5 miles  
Then perform as many rounds as possible of:  
10 [push-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-up?m=push-up)   
20 [lunges](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-walking-lunge)   
30 [sit-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-abmat-sit-up?m=deadlift)   

Post rounds completed to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230929). 
***  

**Scaling:**   
Deconditioned athletes should reduce the overall volume of this workout while still maintaining the general format and bodyweight movements. 

**Beginner option:**   
On a **20-minute** clock:  
**Jog 1 mile**  
Then perform as many rounds as possible of:  
**5 assisted** push-ups   
**10** lunges   
**20** sit-ups

sections.section_content:
15 minutes to build to a heavy single **Power snatch**

Then:
**Power snatch**: 2-2-2-2-2 at 80%
section_notes: Focus on going heavy from the ground to overhead.
Newer athletes should focus on solid mechanics.

metadata.raw_content:
15 minutes to build to a heavy single [power snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-snatch)  
Then,   
Power snatch 2-2-2-2-2 at 80% 

Post snatch load to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230930). 
***  
**Scaling:**  
Watch “[The Power Snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-snatch)” and focus on going heavy from the ground to overhead. All athletes can go heavy in the power snatch, with newer athletes focusing on solid mechanics. Calculate 80% of your heaviest successful lift, and perform 5 sets of 2 reps.
